🎥🍿: Super Troopers 3 (2026)

The boys in blue are back, and this time the Vermont State Troopers are ready to bring even more ridiculous chaos to the road. When a new investigation puts them face-to-face with unexpected trouble, the team’s bizarre tactics, wild teamwork, and completely unpredictable methods create a mission only they could handle.

Reuniting the original cast, Super Troopers 3 returns with the franchise’s signature comedy, outrageous pranks, unforgettable characters, and the hilarious chemistry fans have been waiting years for. Get ready for another unforgettable ride filled with nonstop laughs and classic Broken Lizard madness.

source_details.synopsis: Super Troopers 3 (billed as Super Troopers 3: Farva’s Wedding, onscreen only) is a 2026 American comedy film directed by Jay Chandrasekhar. A sequel to the 2018 film Super Troopers 2, the film was written by and stars the Broken Lizard comedy team, made up of Chandrasekhar, Kevin Heffernan, Steve Lemme, Paul Soter and Erik Stolhanske. Super Troopers 3 was released in the United States by Searchlight Pictures on August 7, 2026, it received mixed reviews from critics.
